Derived mean of drift and climb vertical inputs.

While set, firing sends the weapon's firing-start/stop wielder animation events and raises wielder action bit 55 (the Maxigun's stationary firing). There is no per-weapon movement multiplier in weapon data.

The weapon type's firing sound as a catalogue sound name (hd2.sounds.list(); docs/weapon-sounds.md): ProjectileWeapon +252/+256 (loop start/stop), +260 (per-shot event) and +237 (MIDI flag), written as the catalogue entry's writes relative to the weapon's own values. Instantiation-only; not live-tested.
Readable schema-labelled enum; valid replacement members are not sufficiently proven for safe authoring.

Guarded crosshair policy: off writes CrosshairDamageIndicatorOnly; on restores the weapon's own crosshair style, or AssaultRifle where the baseline is hidden. Weapons whose crosshair type does not select a mapped style are read-only.

The weapon's four packed native fire-mode slots as an ordered list; the first mode is the default. Only Automatic, Single and Burst are authored, on conventional projectile weapons without special trigger functions.
Rounds fired per burst; weapon-wide and used only by the Burst mode.

The weapon's three native rate-of-fire slots in the order the weapon menu lists them {X, Y, Z} (rpm; 0 = no mode in that slot). The middle one (Y, weapon.fire_rate) is the default and never 0; the ROF selector visits the filled slots Y -> Z -> X. X and Z are filled only where a selector is bound or bindable.
The WeaponFunctionType bound to the left weapon-function input. Only an unbound input takes a selector this weapon can host (rate_of_fire, programmable_ammo), written together with what it selects.
The WeaponFunctionType bound to the right weapon-function input. Only an unbound input takes a selector this weapon can host (rate_of_fire, programmable_ammo), written together with what it selects.
The projectile every shot fires while the ProgrammableAmmo weapon function is on (ProjectileWeapon +576): a second, player-selectable projectile.
The trait labels the armory and loadout menus show (five localization string IDs); presentation only, independent of gameplay.
The penetration label the armory shows (LIGHT/MEDIUM/HEAVY ARMOR PENETRATING, LIGHT ANTI-TANK, ANTI-TANK); presentation only. Gameplay penetration is damage.ap_* on the projectile.
The numeric field is readable, but valid enum members and change semantics are not sufficiently proven.
Guarded reordering of a weapon's proven native three-slot mode vector; only Full Auto and Semi Auto members already present in that vector are accepted.
Readable underlying magazine value; a default customization may replace the effective magazine.
Derived as max(1, floor(magazines_from_supply / 2)); edit magazines_from_supply.
Derived sum of feed_capacity_1 and feed_capacity_2.
Derived as floor(rounds_from_supply / 2); edit rounds_from_supply.
Derived from heat.cool_per_second and the native cold multiplier.
Derived from heat.cool_per_second and the native hot multiplier.
No owned WeaponHeat scalar reproduced warmup across beam and projectile heat families.
The qualitative reload-needed behavior has no proven scalar owner.
Derived as floor(heatsink.from_supply / 2); edit heatsink.from_supply.

Readable native record identity; use attack.projectile for guarded compatible reference replacement.
